title: SDLC Model Registry
description: Schema for plugins/sdlc/config/models.json — the machine-read single source of truth mapping a short `tag` (used in agent .md frontmatter `model: <tag>` and other local/plugin files) to the concrete Claude `model_id`, and each model's `pricing` (USD per MTok, used for telemetry cost accounting). `pipeline_tiers` MIRRORS the is_valid_tier list in plugins/sdlc/hooks/enforce-agent-model.sh — keep them in sync.

pipeline_tiers.description: Tags the pipeline dispatches and the enforcement hook validates. Every entry MUST also appear as a `tag` in `models`.

cache_write_multipliers.description: Prompt-cache CREATION price relative to a model's input rate (Anthropic standard, model-independent). The usage tool multiplies the per-turn ephemeral cache-creation token split by these before pricing at the input rate.

models.description: Every available model, keyed by a unique `tag`.

estimation_baselines.description: Per-dispatch token baselines used ONLY by the Step 1d-1 dry-run cost preview. Never used for billing or the cost cap — those read transcript-derived actuals (ADR-0005/0011). Keys are pipeline tiers; underscore-prefixed keys are free-form provenance notes.

input.description: Uncached input tokens for one dispatch. Small by design — nearly the whole prompt is served from cache after the first turn.

cache_read.description: Prompt-cache READ tokens summed across the phase's turns. The dominant cost term: a phase re-reads its accumulated prefix every turn.

cache_write.description: Prompt-cache CREATION tokens (priced at input rate x cache_write_multipliers.ephemeral_5m).

tag.description: Short alias used in local/plugin files (e.g. opus, sonnet, sonnet-4-6). Unique across the registry.

model_id.description: The real Claude model string used to invoke the model and for telemetry (e.g. claude-sonnet-5).

pricing.description: USD per million tokens. Read by the pipeline for telemetry cost accounting. Optional per model — a model with no pricing yields cost_usd: null in telemetry (excluded from the total).

note.description: Optional annotation, e.g. a time-limited intro price and its expiry.
